subject: Upcoming Family Reunion Event Details
body: Dear family members, We are excited to announce the details for the upcoming family reunion event. The event will be held on Saturday, July 10th, at Green Park from 10 AM to 4 PM. There will be games, activities, and a potluck lunch. Please RSVP by June 30th to confirm your attendance and let us know what dish you will be bringing. We look forward to reconnecting with everyone and creating new memories together! Best regards, The Family Reunion Planning Committee
